description: Commit ae9f910 documents --shard_size as a float and says zero disables sharding, while the preexisting parser requires an integer and the allocator treats zero as a zero-byte threshold that creates a new shard after each nonempty module group.
trigger: Follow the new guide by passing --shard_size 1.5, or pass zero while compiling multiple modules with positive tensor sizes.
expected_behavior: The documented fractional value is accepted, and zero produces an unsharded output.
actual_behavior: Argparse rejects fractional text. With zero, every positive module after a nonempty shard causes another shard because no disabling branch exists.

introductions.scope: The commit introduces both incorrect shard-size statements; the conflicting parser and allocator behavior already exist in the root tree.
